en.headline: CAVALLUNA equestrian theatre continues at Kai Tak through Sunday
en.dek: The European horse-and-theatre production, making its first Asian stop, has remaining performances at Kai Tak Arena from Thursday evening to 13 September.
body: CAVALLUNA – Gate to the Otherworld is running at Kai Tak Arena this week, the production’s first engagement in Asia after tours of more than 30 European cities.

Kai Tak Sports Park and the Hong Kong Tourism Board list performances on 8 September and from 10 to 13 September at the Grand Hall, 38 Shing Kai Road. Remaining shows include Thursday at 7pm, Friday evening, and afternoon and evening sessions on Saturday and Sunday. The organiser, W2E (HK) Ltd, describes a 2.5-hour programme with a 25-minute interval, featuring 54 horses with an international dance ensemble. The Hong Kong Jockey Club is named as exclusive presenting partner and cultural host.

Published ticket prices on the venue site start at HK$395 for Category 3 seats, with higher tiers up to a six-seat VIP table. Tickets are sold through Hong Kong Ticketing. English narration is used, with traditional and simplified Chinese subtitles.

zh.headline: CAVALLUNA馬術劇場啟德續演至週日
zh.dek: 歐洲馬術劇場《穿梭異境》亞洲首站在啟德體藝館上演，本周四晚至9月13日仍有場次，由香港賽馬會呈獻。
body: 《CAVALLUNA 馬術X劇場 穿梭異境》本周在啟德體藝館上演，是該製作首次在亞洲設站，此前曾在歐洲三十多個城市巡演。
啟德體育園及香港旅遊發展局公布，演出日期為9月8日及10日至13日，地點為承啟道38號啟德體藝館競技場。餘下場次包括周四晚上7時、周五晚場，以及周六、週日下午及晚上場。主辦單位W2E（HK）Ltd指節目長約兩小時半，中場休息25分鐘，演出有54匹馬及國際舞蹈組。香港賽馬會為獨家呈獻及文化合作夥伴。
場地公布票價由類別3的395港元起，另設較高票價及六人貴賓桌。門票經快達票發售，旁白為英語，並配繁體及簡體中文字幕。
